content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by Disclosing Party that is marked as confidential or is otherwise confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
